home.welcome.title: Welcome to Simplify Living
home.welcome.subtitle: I'm so glad you're here!
home.welcome.p1: Is your home in chaos, no matter how often you tidy up?
home.welcome.p2: Do you feel stressed and frustrated?
home.welcome.p3: Are you looking for support on your journey to create a home that truly feels good to you?
home.welcome.p4: Then you're in the right place!
home.welcome.p5: Simplify Living helps you gain clarity about what you want—and don't want—in your home and life.
home.how-it-works.title: How it works
home.how-it-works.p1: Using the KonMari® Method, I'll guide you toward your personal vision of a calm and organized home.
home.how-it-works.p2: At the center of the process is you: your ideal home, and the small, practical steps that will take you there.
home.how-it-works.subtitle: Does it spark joy?
home.how-it-works.p3: The KonMari® Method is built around this simple question.
home.how-it-works.p4: Through the process of selecting only those things that inspire joy, you can identify precisely what you love—and what you need.
home.about-me.title: Simone Hagen
home.about-me.p1: You might be wondering: why would anyone turn tidying up into their career.
home.about-me.p2: Find out more about me and why helping people create order brings me so much joy.
home.services.title: Packages
home.services.p1: We'll organize your closet to its full potential in an easy and fun way.
home.services.p2: We'll reduce your paperwork and create an organizational system for you.
home.services.p3: Together with the children, we'll create order in a playful and age-appropriate way.
home.services.p4: We'll tidy up your entire household and arrange it in a optimal way.

home.testimonials.title: Testimonials

home.testimonials.items.name: Mirj
home.testimonials.items.text: The sessions with Simone have even exceeded my expectations. She totally helped me to relax and stay focused on the task at hand.

home.testimonials.items.name: Karin
home.testimonials.items.text: Thanks to Simplify Living, I've learned to approach both my personal and professional life more mindfully. With Simone's careful guidance and inspiring support, I'm able to make decisions with greater clarity. It brings me a new sense of ease.

home.testimonials.items.name: Paedi
home.testimonials.items.text: I decluttered my clothes with Simone. Even though I now own less, I find what I really like much faster. My wardrobe is clear and organized. It truly feels like a new normal.

home.testimonials.items.name: Stef
home.testimonials.items.text: By bringing order to my home, I've gained clarity in my mind. Now I have the mental space for what really matters.

home.final-cta.title: Ready to Simplify Your Life?

home.final-cta.p2: Get in touch now! Free and no strings attached.
